name: baltor-library
description: Search the Baltor library, stage a selected item or complete package with exact byte checks, and place a fetched skill byte for byte

interface.shortDescription: Search Baltor, stage exact files and place a fetched skill.
interface.longDescription: A first-party skill with a Python standard library client. It searches the Baltor library, checks versions and digests, stages a selected item or package in a new folder, and places a fetched skill in this client's skill folder byte for byte. It never runs what it downloads.
interface.defaultPrompt: Search the Baltor library for material this task needs, stage the one item I select with its exact byte checks, and place it with the install command if it is a skill.
